text.tspan: MASS EVENT
@unhappychoice merges deps across 15 repos. Dependabot weeps with relief.
BREAKING NEWS
@unhappychoice drops 120 commits on a Monday. Weekend? Never heard of it.
SECURITY ALERT
@unhappychoice personally neutralizes CRLF injection in cycle-flyer. Crisis averted.
NIX DRAMA
@unhappychoice battles crates.io 403 errors through Nix. Emerges victorious.
STAGGERING
@unhappychoice fires off 63 approvals in 7 days. Rubber stamp reportedly worn through.
LLM WATCH
@unhappychoice syncs LiteLLM pricing into splashboard three times. Costs monitored.
HISTORIC MERGE
@unhappychoice touches Java, Ruby, Rust, and JS deps in single week. Polyglot mode: on.
ECONOMISTS STUNNED
@unhappychoice adds 9,094 lines and deletes 7,630 more. Net gain: order from chaos.
